answer_text: Azure uses its own default IPsec settings for cloud VPNs, including how it handles PFS. A tunnel that comes up but fails at rekey is commonly caused by a Diffie-Hellman (DH) group mismatch between sides. Make sure the DH/PFS group configured in the Cato Management Application matches Azure’s expectation; configure the DH group parameter to match your edge device configuration so the DH group is the same on both sides.
